summary: Functional Brands Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to CEO Eric Gripentrog's employment agreement, replacing a prior $500,000 RSU award with fully vested incentive stock options to purchase 3,500,000 shares at $0.0055/share (total exercise price $19,250, grant-date fair value ~$14,685). The options are immediately exercisable with a 10-year term. This is a routine compensatory arrangement for an executive, not a special situation event. No change in control, strategic review, or shareholder action is involved. No further action or arbitrage angle applies.
